page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i5e.32xlarge is a KVM-hypervised server instance configured with 128 dedicated Intel Xeon 6763P-C vCPUs operating at a baseline frequency of 2.9 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The system is equipped with 1024.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 8.0 GB of RAM per core.

A primary characteristic of this instance is its integrated local storage, featuring 61,435 GB of SSD capacity. For high-throughput data transfers, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 320 Gbps. It does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses or dedicated GPU hardware.

Given the high density of both memory and local SSD storage, this instance class is designed for workloads requiring massive local data persistence and high-speed network throughput. The qualitative cost profile reflects a high-resource-density configuration where local storage and memory capacity are bundled directly with dedicated compute resources. It is suited for large-scale databases, data warehousing, and high-throughput storage-intensive applications.
